title: ID0444454-DC/Si-D/AT-[Multiple]High Volume of Logs in SCB
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: "High Volume of Logs in SCB" in EU
Workaround: Charger came back on its own due to FileHandlerHF
Solution: Update to v8.0.5

additional_info.body:

Amit Gupta
